==Chapters==
* Chapter 1: [[DPA01|In Search of the Legendary Pokémon Dialga!!]]
* Chapter 2: [[DPA02|Hareta's Very First Pokémon Battle!!]]
* Chapter 3: [[DPA03|The Mystery Boy, Jun!!]]
* Chapter 4: [[DPA04|Win with Teamwork!!]]
* Chapter 5: [[DPA05|Find Munchlax!!]]

==Important events==
* [[Hareta]] meets [[Mitsumi]].
* [[Professor Rowan]] sends them on a quest to find {{p|Dialga}}.
* [[Hareta]] meets [[Team Galactic]] for the first time.
